static_traits.name: Zhang Kai
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, with no immediate family members
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends but hesitates to confide in friends when encountering negative emotions; occasional conflicts with colleagues
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never received psychotherapy before; negative thinking patterns existing since adolescence
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, relatively good logicality, high cooperativeness; neutral emotional tone

basic_info.main_problem: I often interpret situations catastrophically, leading to disappointment and frustration; triggered when things do not go as planned or as wished, negative thinking has affected my mood and Work efficiency.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because negative thinking patterns have started to affect work performance and overall physical and mental health; I hope to learn a more balanced perspective, and to challenge and restructure catastrophic thinking.
growth_experiences: Since adolescence, when things did not go as planned or challenges arose, gradually formed a Catastrophizing pattern; negative automatic thoughts appearing frequently, stress at a moderate level, the impact on mood and Work efficiency worsening over time.
In the past when facing personal or professional challenges, coped by seeking friends' support and self-care; never received psychotherapy before, and also No major physical illness.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough (failure means I am terrible)
My worth depends on whether I achieve perfect results

special_situations.event: Went to the library to find desired books (such as the Harry Potter and Game of Thrones series) but found they had all been borrowed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If things do not go as I planned, this experience has no value / equals being ruined
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating the entire experience with extreme evaluation, immediately retreating emotionally or distracting to avoid disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This library trip is completely ruined.

special_situations.event: Projects at Work not yet progressing as planned or results falling short of Anticipation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If results have not reached Anticipation, it means my ability is insufficient
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Falls into rumination, hard to focus on the current task; tries distraction and positive self-talk for brief relief
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough / I cannot do well.

special_situations.event: The most recent presentation not achieving the desired effect
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not do well this time, it means I will never do well
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Anticipating the worst outcome to reduce disappointment, briefly distracting to avoid painful emotions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am terrible, I will never do well.

special_situations.event: When reviewing one's work performance, more easily recalls failures and ignores past success cases
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive evidence does not count, the current mistake is the true proof of my ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive feedback and success experiences, continuously focusing on problems to push oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those successes do not count / were just luck.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be affirmed and recognized, and to prove self-worth through controllable plans and outcomes
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and not being recognized, worrying about disappointing others and triggering relationship conflicts
defense_goal: Avoiding failure and being negated through self-criticism and raising standards
Restrains expressing negative emotions and seeking help, avoiding being seen as 'burdening others'

object_relations.self_representation: A help-seeker who may trouble others
object_relations.object_representation: Friends who would be dragged down by my negative emotions

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to express negative feelings and needs more concretely to friends or the counselor
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Expressing negativity burdens others and may be seen as complaining
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Restrained tone, brief responses, quickly turns to facts and task details, reducing emotion words.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about feelings of failure experiences, or challenged on black-and-white explanations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The other is judging whether I am good enough, needing me to give 'reasonable grounds' proving I am not lazy/incapable
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Stay calm and rational, give seemingly thorough Interpretations to Displace the emotional focus, such as 'I am just worried about affecting everyone'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked to stop and experience the disappointment and frustration of this moment
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Going straight into emotions would mean losing control or seeming weak
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Retells the course of events in objective, general language, avoiding touching subjective feelings.

manifestations: When results fall short of Anticipation, thinking 'all efforts were wasted'
Evaluating experiences in catastrophic and all-or-nothing ways, negating their value and meaning
outcomes: Disappointment and rising Sense of frustration, Decreased drive

manifestations: Living alone, with no immediate family members
Has friends but hesitates to share negative emotions, worrying about 'burdening others'
outcomes: Insufficient Social support mobilization, more prone to rumination when facing difficulties
Occasional tension and conflict in colleague relationships

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Restraining self-expression of negative feelings with 'should not trouble others / do not want to seem complaining'
Internalizes 'must proceed as planned' as a standard for evaluating self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently blaming oneself 'I am not good enough', over-scrutinizing one's feelings and words before expressing emotions
Repressing the urge to seek help for fear of troubling others

positive_force: Having some self-observation and Reflection ability, able to Identify automatic thoughts
Willing to seek professional help and try distraction and positive self-talk
Has a few reliable friends as potential support resources
negative_force: Deeply ingrained catastrophic and all-or-nothing thinking patterns, prone to negating positive evidence
Strongly binds self-worth to outcomes; devalues the self upon setbacks
Cautious and restrained attitude toward expressing negative emotions and seeking support
Rumination causes focus to decline, further affecting work efficiency and sleep and diet

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic and all-or-nothing thinking when falling short of Anticipation
antecedent: Work projects or presentations not yet completed as planned
target_behavior.core_reason: Long-formed negative core beliefs ('I am not good enough') and over-reliance on perfect outcomes, making them equate setbacks with overall failure
target_behavior.function: Escaping uncertainty and failure, gaining brief control and certainty through extreme evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Emotional dysregulation (disappointment, frustration), Decreased work efficiency, increased conflict and Interpersonal tension

target_behavior.behavior: In negative emotions, avoids asking friends for help and expressing needs
antecedent: When encountering Work setbacks or unsatisfactory results
When strong disappointment and self-blame arise
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about becoming a burden to others and being negatively evaluated, internalizing 'must not trouble others' as a rule
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential rejection or shame, maintaining the surface harmony of self-image and relationships
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient Social support mobilization, Worsening rumination, Loneliness and Accumulated stress

target_behavior.behavior: Emotional fluctuations affect physiological rhythms (sleep and diet)
antecedent: After ruminating on failure and Self-denial
Goals not yet achieved under high-pressure Work situations
target_behavior.core_reason: High arousal and Anxiety maintained by negative automatic thoughts, interfering with relaxation and self-care behaviors
target_behavior.function: No clear functional benefit, mostly poor byproducts (emotion–physiology coupling)
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep and diet disturbance, further weakening energy and Work performance, forming a negative cycle
